payload.title: Explain responses: compact encoding so Rust and larger programs fit under the caps
payload.description: Rust programs using sort, u128 or {:#x} run 25k-32k instructions and end as output_limit_exceeded (cap 20000 instructions, 4 MB; about 130 bytes of JSON per instruction). Use a function-name table and compact fields to shrink the response, then raise the instruction cap; update the web client.
